items.title: Meta Ads: $315.87 spend, 24 leads, $13.16 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: No meta-ads.json had been written since 2026-09-08 (which itself covered only through 2026-09-07), so this run widens the window to 2026-09-08 through 2026-09-13 (6 days, within the 7-day cap) to close the gap. Over that window Meta spent $315.87, entirely on the sole actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 24 leads at $13.16 CPL — close to the 7-day trailing baseline (2026-09-07 to 2026-09-13: $364.06 / 29 leads, ~$12.55 CPL), so no anomaly. Account is ACTIVE, the other three campaigns remain PAUSED, and no ads are flagged.

needs_attention: Gap in coverage: the last successful meta-ads run (2026-09-08) covered only through 2026-09-07; no meta-ads.json exists for 2026-09-09 through 2026-09-13. Today's window was widened to 2026-09-08–2026-09-13 (6 days, at the edge of but within the 7-day cap) to close it — confirm no earlier run silently failed during that span.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 24, matching the counted leads exactly), continuing the pattern flagged on 2026-08-31, 2026-09-02, and 2026-09-07/08. No discrepancy in the counted total, but this is now a recurring signal that the script's lead-action set should be extended rather than continuing to hand-note it.
